Ultra-realistic retro fashion street photography, vertical format approx 3:4, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a gray metal bench in a semi-outdoor industrial building corridor, behind her is a large area of off-white old brick wall, exposed concrete beams and columns, and gray drainage pipes. The overall look presents 90s–2000s Japanese magazine fashion editorial + modern minimalist industrial space + snapshot feel, quiet, restrained, with a bit of retro urban temperament.

The photographer is located directly in front of the subject, slightly to the left, about 2–2.5 meters away, using an equivalent 35–50mm lens, with the camera position slightly lower than the subject's chest and tilted slightly upwards. The subject is located in the center-right of the frame, occupying about 75–80% of the frame height, captured completely from the top of the head to the feet; a large amount of empty corridor, columns, and floor is preserved on the left, while the bench and personal belongings are preserved on the right. Do not crop tightly, do not over-blur the background, let the industrial environment be clearly established.

The subject is a young adult East Asian female, small-boned, with narrow shoulders, a slender and natural upper body, a short and clearly cinched waist, naturally wide pelvis and hips, and long thighs with soft, realistic volume, with calves gradually tapering. The overall look is a naturally elegant, light hourglass proportion; do not generate an exaggeratedly voluptuous figure, athletic muscular legs, or paper-thin proportions.

The subject is sitting sideways on the bench, her body facing about 30–40° to the front-left of the frame, hips sitting on the right side of the bench, and her upper body tilting significantly toward the front-left, with one shoulder higher than the other, forming a soft diagonal line. The head also tilts toward the subject's left following the body, the face turns toward the camera, eyes looking directly at the photographer, expression quiet, slightly lazy and detached, lips naturally slightly parted, no toothy smile.

The left hand reaches down from the left side of the body, fingers pinching a folded English newspaper/financial newspaper, the newspaper naturally hanging toward the ground, the layout showing black and white text, gray images, and bold headlines, but the text remains blurred and unreadable. The wrist wears a string of dark red small bead bracelets.

The right hand hangs naturally on the right side of the body, holding a red translucent/glossy low-heeled shoe, grasping the heel or back, letting the shoe hang in front of the bench. The right wrist wears a vintage watch with a gold case + green rectangular dial, and the fingers wear a few silver/gold rings.

The legs are the core of the image: the subject is wearing semi-transparent berry red / wine red-pinkish stockings, the stockings completely covering from the thighs to the toes, the color is very obvious, but natural skin tone can still be seen through them. The material is thin nylon/stocking texture, about 15–25D, the surface is smooth with a slight sheen, not a thick cotton sock feel.

One leg is extended significantly from the bench toward the bottom-left of the frame, the knee is slightly bent, and the stocking-wrapped toe is stretched forward and slightly pressed down, the foot being closest to the lens, forming a natural perspective enlargement; the other leg is bent and close to the bottom of the bench, the sole of the foot on the ground or hanging slightly above the floor. Both feet are not wearing shoes, only red stockings.

On the ground at the bottom of the frame is a pair of berry red/rose red low-heeled ballet shoes / kitten heel pumps that match the one in the hand. The shoe style is round toe or slightly square-round toe, the upper is semi-transparent or gauze material, with thin red piping and a small bow, the heel is very low and small, about 3–4cm. The subject's right hand holds the other shoe of the same style, forming a clear "one on the ground, one in hand" relationship.

The upper body wears a cream white / ivory white slim-fit long-sleeved knit top, the fabric is thin and soft, slightly sheer but maintaining normal complete coverage. The neckline is a wide shallow U-neck/boat neck, revealing the collarbone and shoulder-neck lines. The body of the garment fits tightly to the waist, forming natural folds.

The sleeves are long and slightly sheer, with small white ruffles/lace edges near the wrist, carrying a bit of retro feminine detail. Do not generate a regular white T-shirt or thick sweater.

The lower body wears a high-saturation bright red / dark red knit mini skirt, the skirt style is simple and fits the hips, the length is about below the root of the thigh, the fabric has dense longitudinal knit texture or slight ribbing. The skirt waist is near the natural waistline, no pleats, no plaid, no leather.

The subject wears a short white pearl necklace, the pearls are medium-small in size, close to the base of the neck, adding a sense of retro elegance. Overall jewelry is few but refined, do not add exaggerated earrings or large necklaces.

The subject has long dark black-brown wavy hair, length near the waist, with natural thick volume. The top of the head is slightly side-parted, there are no thick straight bangs on the forehead, and long stray hairs on both sides modify the face shape. The hair hangs down from both sides of the shoulders, forming obvious large S-shaped curls in front of the chest and on the left side, the ends of the hair are soft with a natural fluffy feel. No short hair, high ponytail, or excessive perming.

The face shape is small and somewhat oval, with a soft jawline, and the skin tone is fair and slightly warm. Eyebrows are naturally thin, dark brown almond eyes, slight double eyelids, extremely fine eyeliner; the bridge of the nose is small and straight, and the lips are low-saturation rose bean paste color. The makeup is clean, with a Japanese retro magazine feel, preserving real skin texture, no internet-celebrity style skin smoothing.

The scene is a semi-outdoor industrial building corridor / parking garage / gallery back hall passage. The background on the right is a whole wall of gray-rice white painted brick wall, the brick outlines, mortar joints, wear, and uneven coating are clearly visible, and the wall surface has slight aging particles.

Exposed concrete ceiling beams, rectangular structural beams, gray drainage pipes, and connecting elbows are visible on the upper left. Toward the back left, there is a huge light gray circular load-bearing column extending from the ground to the top. There can be a small electrical box/sensor on the wall, but no prominent text should appear.

The subject is sitting on a minimalist gray metal bench, the seat surface composed of multiple horizontal metal strips, supported by thin gray metal legs, the overall style leaning toward industrial design. On the right side of the bench is a high-gloss red small square bag / vanity bag, the material is shiny patent leather or PVC.

Above the red small bag is a pale yellow / cream yellow soft beret or plush hat, slightly collapsed in shape, with a soft color. Next to it is an open newspaper/magazine naturally spread on the bench surface.

The ground is gray coarse-grained concrete / cement floor, with small stones, wear, and a few light-colored water stains/damp spots. The subject's extended red stocking foot forms a strong color contrast with the gray ground.

The light is soft natural daylight entering from the open space on the left, overall leaning toward an overcast day or large window-side diffused light. The subject's left face, chest, white top, and front leg are softly illuminated; the subject's right body, brick wall, and bench enter deeper gray shadows, forming natural light and dark levels.

No strong flash, no studio softbox. The white brick wall is overall warm gray or ivory gray, not pure white; the red skirt, stockings, shoes, and handbag are the main color focuses of the entire image.
